capture.scope: authored controlled workload; final quarter idle; source-owned 5x7 font

compression.scope: publication begin/chunk/commit packets; excludes handshake, acknowledgements, TLS and WebSocket framing

wasm.timingScope: one Node/WASM replay including negotiation; excludes state export, rendering, network and input

network.scope: Actual loopback TLS stream including handshake, WebSocket upgrade/framing, WASM applied acknowledgements and simulated presented acknowledgements; excludes TCP/IP headers, browser assets, authorization service, rendering and input. Synthetic replay endpoint, not production host. Delays are per message delivery, not network emulation.

recovery.scope: Actual loopback TLS stream including handshake, WebSocket upgrade/framing, WASM applied acknowledgements and simulated presented acknowledgements; excludes TCP/IP headers, browser assets, authorization service, rendering and input.
